title: Very good app
body: As a todoist user, I moved here because this app really did work better for me in pretty much all ways. However, I would like to see the developers integrating faster iCloud syncing because it does take a couple of seconds to sync between devices compared to the instant syncing in todoist. Very beautiful app, would recommend anyone reading this to give it a try
author: Hassan Alison

title: Procrastinating be gone
body: So I just started using this app today, and it’s already been so good to me. I downloaded two other apps with this one to see which one I liked most and I honestly stuck to this one and deleted the others. I’m an IB student getting closer to graduating soon and since distance learning, it’s been so hard to keep on track of everything, this app helps me keep track of home, school, routine (personal) work and so much more! I am using the app for free although there are better features if paid for. It’s a good app for keeping track of day to day activities and staying productive🙂 I would definitely recommend.
